name: Grave Domain

source.note: Entered from the 2025 Unearthed Arcana (Horror Subclasses) and published reviews of Ravenloft: The Horrors Within; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Clerics who keep watch over the line between the living and the dead, laying the undead to rest and holding death off for those with work unfinished.

feature.name: Circle of Mortality
feature.summary: Once per turn +1d4 Necrotic against a Bloodied creature; healing dice for someone at 0 Hit Points are always maximum.
feature.text: Pull of Death: a Bloodied creature that takes damage from your spell or attack roll takes 1d4 more Necrotic (once per turn). Return to Life: whenever your spell or Channel Divinity would heal a creature at 0 Hit Points with dice, skip the roll and take every die at its maximum.

feature.name: Grave Domain Spells
feature.summary: Bane, Chill Touch, Detect Evil and Good, Gentle Repose and Ray of Enfeeblement always prepared; more at levels 5, 7 and 9.
feature.text: Always prepared from the Cleric level shown: 3 Bane, Chill Touch, Detect Evil and Good, Gentle Repose, Ray of Enfeeblement; 5 Revivify, Vampiric Touch; 7 Blight, Dispel Evil and Good; 9 Hold Monster, Raise Dead.

feature.name: Path to the Grave
feature.summary: Bonus Action, Channel Divinity: curse a creature within 30 feet (Disadvantage on attacks and saves); a hit can end it for 1d8 + Cleric level Necrotic or Radiant.
feature.text: Cost: a Bonus Action and a Channel Divinity use, holy symbol raised. Target: a creature in sight within 30 ft. Until the start of your next turn it rolls attacks and saving throws at Disadvantage. The first time you, or an ally in your sight, hits it with an attack roll, you may cash the curse in (free) for 1d8 + your Cleric level extra damage on that hit, Necrotic or Radiant as you choose.

feature.name: Sentinel at Death's Door
feature.summary: Reaction: halve the damage of an attack that hits you or a Bloodied creature you see within 30 feet (Wisdom-modifier uses per Long Rest).
feature.text: Trigger: an attack roll hits you, or hits a Bloodied creature in your sight within 30 ft. Reaction: that attack does half damage. Uses: Wisdom modifier (at least 1) per Long Rest.

feature.name: Divine Reaper
feature.summary: Channel Divinity lets a one-target Necromancy or domain spell take a second target; heal 3 × Cleric level when an enemy dies near you (once per Short Rest).
feature.text: Enhanced Necromancy: spend a Channel Divinity use when casting a single-target Necromancy spell of level 5 or lower, or one of your Grave Domain spells, to aim it at a second creature in range too (each target needs its own costly or consumed components). Keeper of Souls: once per Short or Long Rest, when a foe dies within 60 ft and you aren't Incapacitated, you or someone you see within 60 ft heals three times your Cleric level.
